body:
zmx.sh lists community projects; three matter here.

zmx-picker (`zp`, 0BSD, shell script): fzf picker over running sessions *and* git/jj repos beneath given roots, with scrollback preview; sessions created from a repo are named `<repo>.<n>` and started in the repo; any labels are displayed and fuzzy-searchable, so `key=value` narrows the list; Ctrl-N create, Ctrl-X kill, Tab mark; `--print` emits start-dir and full session name NUL-terminated for composition. It does not write labels and does not own birth (calls zmx attach).

pi-zmx: a pi extension with zmx_run / zmx_wait / zmx_history / zmx_list / zmx_kill / zmx_attach, non-blocking run, human-in-the-loop attach for password prompts, session named from the pi session by default. That is the agent surface, already shaped the way an agent wants it.

emacs-term-sessions: persistent terminals in Emacs, local and remote — the generic version of dl-zmx.el.

Also: zsm (a TUI session manager), rootshell (an iOS client with live previews), zmosh (a mosh-like fork adding encrypted UDP reconnect). And the documented SSH workflow - RemoteCommand zmx attach %k with ControlMaster - is the remote story, so remote needs no transport of our own (h-remote is answered, negatively for v0).
title: The ecosystem already built two of the three surfaces
